description: This Java class 'SavingsAccrualData' is a data container representing accrual information related to savings accounts within the Fineract project. It includes fields like account ID, account number, accrued date, interest receivability, overdraft allowance, and deposit type, along with a method to convert deposit type enumeration data into a firm-specific type.

classes.name: SavingsAccrualData
classes.description: A data class encapsulating accrual details for a savings account, including account info and deposit type conversion logic.

methods.name: getDepositType
methods.description: Returns the deposit account type by converting the stored depositType integer to an EnumOptionData and then to DepositAccountType.
